_startCommandOverride: Set this as the service's Custom Start Command in Railway (Settings -> Deploy). All three backend services share backend/railway.json, which intentionally sets NO startCommand (config-as-code overrides the dashboard — a startCommand there would force this service to run the API). The override below only takes effect because the shared file is silent on startCommand.
_liveness: Celery worker is not an HTTP service, so Railway healthchecks do not apply. Liveness relies on the ON_FAILURE restart policy plus task_acks_late/task_reject_on_worker_lost (app/celery_app.py) so in-flight tasks are redelivered on crash. Manual check: `celery -A app.celery_app.celery_app inspect ping`.
_scaling: Horizontally scalable. CELERY_QUEUES / CELERY_CONCURRENCY env vars override the queue set and concurrency. See infra/railway/SCALING.md and infra/railway/worker-split.example/ for splitting ai/outbound into dedicated services.
